data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual sense, the name Sahi has deep significance. It is believed that those who are truthful and honest in their actions are closer to Allah and are more likely to achieve inner peace and contentment. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "The believer's shade on the Day of Resurrection will be his honest character." (Sahih Muslim). historical_references.reference: Sahi, Al-Hasan ibn Sahl at-Tostari (d. 835 CE) was a Persian Sufi scholar and poet. He is also known as Sahl Tusi or Al-Tusi. He lived during the Abbasid Caliphate and is considered a major figure in early Sufism.

Sahi Tabrizi (1142-1213 CE) was a Persian poet and Sufi master. He is known as Sahi Tabrizi due to his association with the city of Tabriz in Iran. He was a prominent figure in the Suhrawardi order and is famous for his works on Sufi mysticism.
